cases.scenario: Both accept a new rematch with reversed colors, retained setup and agreed time changes; neither can revive the old result.
Guests cannot join public queue; an entry authorizes one automatic game, without a per-match approval or automatic requeue.
Pair human/other agent or different-owner agents with identical time controls; reject human/human and same-owner pairs.
One owner creates multiple entries/games using the same or different models without an arbitrary cap; each entry is consumed once.
Opening the same entry in another tab creates no extra entry/game; Join another game explicitly does.
No search time elapses during own-agent checks; ready entry acceptance starts the ten seconds.
Failed agent check blocks entry and offers Retry or explicit human play, never silent takeover.
Responsive background client stays eligible; a frozen/disconnected waiting entry expires and needs an explicit rejoin.
Waiting selection stays fixed; cancel/rejoin with a new model starts fresh and leaves other games unaffected.
A compatible ready candidate at exactly the cutoff wins over engine fallback; later candidates cannot replace it.
Compete two matchmakers, cancel and fallback on the same entries; at most one assigned game and one opponent survive.
Human or selected agent faces Stockfish 19 Lite with selected time, random colors and standard starting board.
Stockfish download/startup failure still permits agent search, then offers Retry or Keep searching if no match.
Late candidate, late engine ready and reconnected duplicate tab cannot replace a committed opponent.
Friend custom positions never carry into queue entries; colors are random and no color-preference partition exists.
Default opening and 15-second reply abort work for White-to-move and Black-to-move custom FENs; increment is applied exactly once.
Cancel before own first accepted move aborts even after opponent's move; after own first move it resigns, including after a takeback.
Duplicate, stale, illegal and wrong-seat intents neither advance state nor mint clock increments.
cases.expected: Duplicate, stale, illegal and wrong-seat intents neither advance state nor mint clock increments.

cases.scenario: With 20 minutes left, a connected opponent may use all time; no abandonment claim appears merely because no move arrives.
After 60 continuous seconds offline, prompt Claim win or Keep waiting; waiting preserves play and the optional claim.
Reconnect accepted first removes claim eligibility; a claim or normal final outcome accepted first remains final.
Generation, errors, Stop/Retry, navigation, refresh, peer disconnect and control changes do not refund or pause chess time.
Human takeover, agent handoff and model switches apply between accepted moves and fence a late old reply.
Four illegal attempts lose; formatting budget is independent; retry/switch does not reset spent attempts; transport failure alone never resigns.
Mutual draw/takeback consent is required; stale takeback cannot rewind later play or restore elapsed time/budgets.
cases.expected: Mutual draw/takeback consent is required; stale takeback cannot rewind later play or restore elapsed time/budgets.
